verdict.rationale: Otter's own materials say its Mac and Windows desktop app records meetings without a bot joining, and that impromptu Google Meet calls can be captured with no bot present. That is the core of the story. Community complaints describe the bot-based notetaker joining calls, which is a different mode, so they do not contradict the bot-free desktop claim. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how device audio is captured (system audio or mic, per-platform behavior), confirmation that external participants get no notification or auto-shared summary in bot-free mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Record conversations directly from your Mac or Windows desktop, without bots joining the call.
